messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: P1 fired for service 'quota-router' — unexpected global quota enforcement spike. Trigger: 5xx/429 surge from quota-mapper. Link: https://pd.example/incidents/PD12345 — please ack and triage.

alice_oncall: acked. I'm on it. seeing a spike in 429s from frontend -> quota-router. Quick status: some routes failing fast with quota errors, others fine.

ben_platform: looking at the quota-mapper logs now. I see a flood of "QuotaLookup timeout" followed by "applyDefaultQuota: misapplied tenantId=null" errors. Could be a cache invalidation problem after the deploy last night.

carla_sre: pinging infra metrics: memory and CPU for quota-router pods look fine. However, host-level egress to redis for the quota cache shows increased latency.

dana_support: multiple customers reporting timeouts in chat, some saying requests getting 429s intermittently. Customer impact: degraded API success rate ~12% for tokenize/generation routes.

alice_oncall: handoff to ben/carla. I'm going to flip fallback routing to bypass quota-router for high-priority customers while we investigate. Will follow runbook.

carla_sre: agreed. Running runbook step 2 -> enable fallback-route policy for tier=enterprise. Command: ``kubectl apply -f /ops/runbooks/quota-bypass-enterprise.yaml -n prod``. Executing now.

ben_platform: patching quota-mapper hotfix to treat null tenant as no-op instead of failing. Preparing patch, will run canary on two pods. Patch diff: ``- if (!tenant) throw Err; + if (!tenant) log.warn('null tenant, skipping')``.

pagerduty-bot: PD incident PD12345 status: acknowledged by alice_oncall. Escalation timer paused.

alice_oncall: after enabling bypass, enterprise traffic success rate improved to 99%. Still seeing 429s from general pool — looks like some keys stuck in redis with stale expiry.

ben_platform: confirmed. I can see redis latency spikes around 1932109800-1932109900. Running redis-cli to clear problem keys for affected shards. Command: ``redis-cli -h redis-prod-03 KEYS "quota:*:locked" | xargs -r redis-cli -h redis-prod-03 DEL``. Executing now.

carla_sre: note: don't mass-delete keys without scoping. Ben, scope to tenant-prefixed keys we observed: `quota:tenant:xxxxx:locked`.

ben_platform: good catch. Scoped delete applied. Post-cleanup metrics: quota lookup p50 latency down from 320ms to 18ms. 429s dropping.

alice_oncall: rolling restart of quota-mapper pods to pick up hotfix. Command: ``kubectl rollout restart deployment/quota-mapper -n prod``. Doing canary 1/3 then scale.

dana_support: still seeing a handful of customers with errors; was told by support to prepare a short status to post to status.redwood.ai if this persists.

carla_sre: investigation notes: root cause appears to be a combination of (1) deploy yesterday changed cache key format, (2) redis nodes experienced transient high GC/latency leading to timeouts, (3) quota-mapper treated missing tenant key as hard failure. Triggered surge in 429s.

alice_oncall: mitigation summary: bypass routing enabled for enterprise, scoped redis key cleanup, quota-mapper hotfix deployed and rollout in progress. Impact contained to ~10-15 minutes peak for most customers.

ben_platform: monitoring: adding temporary alert suppression for duplicates on PD while we stabilize; keeping one PD incident open for postmortem tracking.

pagerduty-bot: PD incident PD12345 status: status updated -> investigating.

alice_oncall: handing off to carla for overnight watch and postmortem. Carla, can you take post-incident actions: collect logs, timeline, and assign owners for follow-ups (redis ops, deploy regression, runbook improvements)?

carla_sre: taking handoff. I'll create the incident board and start a postmortem draft. Owners: ben_platform (hotfix + deploy regression), infra (redis config + monitoring), devex (improve runbook & fallback playbook), dana_support (customer comms).

dana_support: I'll draft a short customer-facing message: "We experienced a transient quota enforcement issue causing intermittent 429s. Services restored; enterprise customers had an expedited bypass applied. We're performing a root cause analysis and will follow up." Posting to status page after final wording approved.

alice_oncall: final notes: PD acknowledgement done, escalation suppressed, handoff completed. Will add incident tags: severity:P1, impact:partial, duration: ~18m. Good job team :thumbsup:.

carla_sre: adding todo: add telemetry to detect cache key-format drift and an automated migration step in deploy to avoid future misapplied keys.

ben_platform: will follow up tomorrow with logs and the specific commit that introduced the key-format change.

incident-bot: Incident PD12345 closed by alice_oncall at 1932109985 — final state: mitigated, postmortem in progress.

carla_sre: closing thread here, will link postmortem when ready. Thanks all.
